item.title: Youth and Community Development — Procurement: Technical Assistance Services for Organizational Development
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
DYCD's capacity-building and technical assistance programs support DYCD s contracted providers in various areas needed to enhance program services. DYCD is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) in the areas of Organization Development, Fiscal Management, Strength-Based Approaches to Service Delivery, Career Development, Developing a Safe and Supportive Environment, Adult Literacy Support, Mental Health Support and Case Management. These services have been determined to be of high need to support our contracted providers and the work they do for the City of New York.

item.title: Administration for Children's Services — Procurement: Health and Fitness Program for Justice-Involved Youth
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Through this Request for Proposals (RFP), ACS is seeking a qualified vendor to provide health and fitness programming to justice-involved youth. The programs would engage housed youth detained and/or remanded at ACS detention facilities in rigorous physical activity as well as in health and wellness educational programming in accordance with the Center for Disease Control s (CDC) recommendation for adolescents to engage in regular daily, mostly moderate or vigorous intensity, aerobic physical activity.

item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
